append.detail: Closed at three of eight retirements on the owner's delegation (2026-11-10): route-tabs, spaces-toolbar and my-frequency-rows are gone with their pins and the Drafts badge shipped (part 1). The source patch f6dd66168 naming the eight modules is not in the repo. Of the other five candidates, components/spaces/dashboard/space-dashboard.tsx and components/admin/admin-rail-drawer-column.tsx have no importer but are read by six closed rows' probes (SCAN-600, LIVE-431, HYG-121, LIVE-476, LIVE-504, LIVE-513), so retiring them means re-pointing those probes first; lib/layout/header-offset.ts is the LIVE-492 detector, not unused; the remaining two cannot be identified without the patch. A future retirement is its own row.
